sentence_1_it: Bacio mio figlio un centinaio di volte al giorno.
sentence_1_en: I kiss my child a hundred times a day.
sentence_2_it: Suo figlio venne espulso dalla scuola.
sentence_2_en: His son was expelled from school.
sentence_3_it: Ha perso il suo amato figlio.

sentence_2_it: Si sposò due volte ed ebbe più di 20 figli.
sentence_2_en: He married twice and had more than 20 children.

sentence_1_en: He wants to marry my daughter.
sentence_2_it: Vuole dare in sposa sua figlia a un dottore.
sentence_2_en: She wants to marry her daughter to a doctor.
sentence_3_it: Mio padre era figlio di argentini e mia madre era figlia di brasiliani.
sentence_3_en: My father was son of Argentines and my mother was daughter of Brazilians.
